title: CMPSC 121 or CMPSC 131 (Introduction to Programming Techniques)
description: A first programming course: problem solving, control structures, functions, arrays, and basic program design, in versions that differ in language or pace.
notes: Choice slot: Penn State's CMPSC 121 or CMPSC 131. Official descriptions are in data/raw/psu/ (courses-cmpsc page).

title: General Education Course
description: A general education course in the arts, humanities, social sciences, or other knowledge domains, chosen from a university-wide list.

title: CMPSC 122 or CMPSC 132 (Intermediate Programming)
description: A second programming course: object-oriented programming, recursion, and basic data structures such as lists, stacks, and queues.
notes: Choice slot: Penn State's CMPSC 122 or CMPSC 132. Official descriptions are in data/raw/psu/ (courses-cmpsc page).

title: First-Year Seminar
description: A small first-year course that introduces new students to university life, academic skills, and a field of study.

title: CAS 100A or CAS 100B (Effective Speech)
description: A course in oral communication: preparing and delivering speeches and presentations, and analyzing audiences and arguments.
notes: Choice slot: Penn State's CAS 100A or CAS 100B. Official descriptions are in data/raw/psu/ (courses-cas page).

title: Natural Science (GN) Elective
description: A natural science course, such as a further physics course or another approved science course.
notes: Penn State: PHYS 213, PHYS 214, or an approved natural science course (2-3 credits).

title: CMPSC/CMPEN 400-Level Elective
description: An upper-level computer science or computer engineering elective chosen from a department list, such as databases, artificial intelligence, security, operating systems, compilers, or graphics.

title: General Elective (Department List)
description: An elective chosen from a department-approved list, which may include courses in other fields or credits such as ROTC or co-op.

title: General Education Course (Health and Wellness)
description: A short general education course on health, fitness, or well-being.
notes: Penn State GHW domain, 1.5 credits in the plan.
